_comment: TEMPLATE-LOGIN-WALL-SESSION-DOES-NOT-CARRY -- a login on one subdomain minted host-only cookies that a sibling scene host is never offered, and BD had no way to SAY so. Anchors are structural: two def lines, one bare call line and one bare if-line; no digit, quote, '=' or True/False/None on any anchor.
subject: the runner names a jar that covers nothing on the page host (RFC 6265 domain- and path-match), once per host, without refusing, and never breaks the download path

mutants.label: LS-M1 the runner never consults the scope diagnostic
mutants.new: pass  # mutant: the scope seam is not wired into the cookie check

mutants.label: LS-M2 a host-only cookie is treated as covering every subdomain
mutants.old: def domain_matches(cookie_domain: str, host: str) -> bool:
mutants.new:
def domain_matches(cookie_domain: str, host: str) -> bool:
    return True  # mutant: the leading-dot distinction is erased

mutants.label: LS-M3 path scoping is ignored
mutants.old: def path_matches(cookie_path: str, request_path: str) -> bool:
mutants.new:
def path_matches(cookie_path: str, request_path: str) -> bool:
    return True  # mutant: every cookie path covers every request path

mutants.label: LS-M4 the diagnostic goes silent even when nothing applies
mutants.new: elif True or applicable_cookies(jar, url):  # mutant: always silent when no login host is known

mutants.label: LS-M5 the login-host branch goes silent even when none of the login host's cookies apply
mutants.new: if True or applicable_cookies(login_jar, url):  # mutant: the login-host judgement is disabled
